name: FREN 5374
title: Narrative Forms in 20th- and 21st-Century French Literature
description: Narrative in 20th- and 21st-century literature, including its criticism and theory, in traditional and nontraditional literary forms. May be repeated with a change of topic for up to nine credits. May be repeated for a total of 9 credits.
requirement_description: Open to graduate students in LCL, others with instructor consent.
